fields.description: Burj Azizi is planned as a mixed-use tower on Sheikh Zayed Road, bringing residences, holiday homes, penthouses, a hotel and retail into one building. Apartment plans and duplex penthouses have distinct layouts and floor ranges. The ambitious tower-wide concept should be read separately from the unit actually offered for sale.

overview: The 2025 developer launch described a planned 725 m tower with 131+ storeys and one- to three-bedroom apartments plus one- to five-bedroom penthouses. The retrieved brochure presents a narrower one- to three-bedroom penthouse collection; current release scope requires confirmation.
research.locationNote: Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Centre First, Dubai. The exact unit’s access, outlook and assigned floor must be checked against its approved plan.
research.priceNote: The 2025 developer announcement quoted AED 10,000–17,000 per sq ft, a historical rate rather than a current entry price. Property Finder’s rounded AED 9.3 m launch header conflicts with its AED 8.825 m body; fäm’s guide says AED 8 m. No single current project-wide price is adopted.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder’s key box lists 80% construction/20% handover, but its FAQ lists 20% booking/50% construction/30% handover. fäm reports 10/70/20. Each totals 100%, yet none is a verified current unit-specific primary schedule; headline plan and stages are withheld.
research.handoverNote: The developer’s February 2025 sales announcement targeted 2028; Property Finder forecasts August 2030/30 August 2030, also echoed by fäm. These are different dated references, not a confirmed contractual completion. No current primary handover calendar was retrieved.
